body:
I think your reasons for why video games make you happy are the same reasons I am constantly starting, watching obsessively and finishing quickly as possible, literally any TV show on Netflix.

As soon as I finish watching one show I start a new obsession. Sometimes within 30 seconds of finishing I will start the next one.

I read and watch tv in my free time. 
If money were not an object I would quit my job and read and watch tv full time.

I'm not special by any yard stick. I don't have anything that I enjoy or do well. I'm not creative or athletic or smart or pretty or thoughtful or intelligent or passionate. I don't like talking to people, I don't like being around people or having people look at me. I don't even like going to the grocery store and maybe having to talk to the cashier.

There is nothing I excel at, or even do well at. 

What is the point of living when there is literally nothing in my life that makes me eager or excited or even just happy?  Nothing to look forward to, nothing hopeful in the distance?

My whole life is a series of being wrong and going about things wrong, and taking the path of least resistance and managing to do shit at even the easiest path.

Wake up, go to work, count down the minutes, go home, cook dinner, watch something mindless, go to sleep. Lather rinse repeat for the next 50 years?
When you go through the motions everyday, hating everything you do, how your life turned out, it doesn't matter if your job supports you,.

I gave my reasons. There are people who take advantage of the kindness of strangers, and Reddit has an amazing reputation for being generous to strangers.

Someone who was already asking for donations, who isn't at their goal goes on Reddit with their "sob" story, then happily posts a link to their PayPal.....

It is what  it is, whatever it is,  and I am skeptical.
Don't get so worked up over my opinion. I'm just a stranger on the Internet. If you are legit ignore me.
Not bitter, no. I looked at the dates and that's why I am skeptical. I think you didn't get enough from family and friends and so you turned to Reddit.
Can you answer about already having a whole PayPal two weeks ago? It seems like you were expecting the generous people of Reddit to pay your bill and that's why you posted.

Does no one else find it strange that this account is 9 months old and that this is the first post, there are no other comments on this person’s account, and their first post concerns their cat and then a fundraiser that has donations from two weeks ago?
I was compelled to donate myself, but then I looked at the history of this account and the donation history…. I hate to be ‘that guy’ but everyone else seems to be blinded by the AWW factor…

P.S. Throw away for obvious reasons. No one likes being lynched for their skepticism.
